title: Gate-Level Trojan Detection: Counter Time-Bomb Localization
description: Analyze a gate-level Verilog netlist of a small synchronous datapath and produce a structured report classifying every node of interest by functional role (counter, comparator, payload, datapath, io), flagging whether the implementation deviates from its documented specification, and listing any suspect signal names.

expected_outputs.summary: A JSON report stating the design name, an overall trojan-detected verdict, a list of suspect net/gate/register names, a mapping of node names to functional role labels (counter, comparator, payload, datapath, io), and a free-text summary of the analysis method used.

schema.design_name: string, must match module name in inputs/netlist.v
schema.suspect_nodes: array of strings, exact net/reg/gate-output names from inputs/netlist.v
schema.stage_labels: object mapping net/reg/gate-output name to one of: counter, comparator, payload, datapath, io

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of true trigger+payload nodes (counter bits, comparator, payload gate) correctly named or labeled in the submitted report versus the hidden ground-truth node set.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of nodes reported as suspect/trigger/payload that are actually legitimate documented datapath nodes in the hidden ground truth.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken by evaluate.py to parse and grade the submitted trojan_report.json (excludes any optional iverilog/vvp cross-check simulation time).

metrics.name: schema_validity
metrics.description: Binary indicator (1/0) of whether submission/trojan_report.json satisfies the pinned JSON schema (FR1-FR4).
